WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-19'
),
RankedUnderlying AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-19'
)

SELECT a.*, b.*, d.*, e.*, pr.*, f.country_name, g.currency_name, mp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code, r.rating_Value
FROM (
    SELECT
        h.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,
        CAST(h.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) AS id_instrument_new,
        h.portfolio_id AS id_portfolio,
        NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
        h.cppib_sec_id AS id_instrument,
        'CPPIBSEC_ID' AS instrument_id_type,
        h.scd_holding_key_id AS id_source_holding,
        sec.abor_security_group_id AS instrument_subgroup_code,
        h.security_group_name AS instrument_subgroup_name,
        sec.abor_security_type_id AS instrument_type_code,
        h.abor_security_type_name AS instrument_type_name,
        h.abor_security_name AS instrument_name_source,
        h.balance_nominal_number AS quantity,
        h.clean_price AS current_price,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS current_nominal,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS current_nominal_pc,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS market_value,
        h.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency AS cost_value,
        h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS market_value_pc,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_market_value,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_market_value_pc,
        h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS cost_value_pc,
        '2025-06-19' AS business_date,
        h.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency + h.next_dividend_portfolio_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
        h.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency + h.next_dividend_quotation_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
        h.quotation_currency_code AS current_notional_currency,
        h.quotation_currency_code AS market_value_currency,
        h.quotation_currency_code AS quoted_currency_code,
        underlying.cppib_sec_id as underlying_cppib_sec_id
    FROM RankedSecurities sec
    LEFT JOIN holdings.scd_holdings_main h
        ON h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
    LEFT JOIN RankedUnderlying underlying 
        ON sec.abor_underlying_instrument_id = underlying.scd_security_key_id 
        AND underlying.rn = 1
    WHERE h.business_date = '2025-06-19'
      AND sec.rn = 1
      AND (sec.abor_security_group_id, sec.abor_security_type_id) = ('DEP RECT', 'DEP RECT')
) AS a

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) AS cppib_sec_id_new,
        instrument_description,
        instrument_name,
        document_type,
        cusip,
        isin,
        sedol,
        ticker,
        bloomberg_exchange,
        bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
        bloomberg_unique_id,
        currency_code,
        underlying_instrument_cppib_sec_id,
        sub_type,
        CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) AS cppib_party_id_new,
        listing_country_code,
        country_code AS mds_country_code,
        currency_code AS mds_currency_code,
        exchange_name,
        issue_country_iso,
        market_sector_description,
        region_code,
        shares_outstanding_real,
        par_amount,
        callable_flag,
        putable_flag,
        convertible_flag,
        next_coupon_date,
        issue_price,
        bloomberg_exchange,
        delete_date,
        issue_date,
        mic
    FROM asset.asset_equity
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'
) AS b
    ON a.id_instrument_new = b.cppib_sec_id_new

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) AS cppib_party_id_new3,
        party_name,
        bloomberg_company_id,
        domicile_country_code,
        incorp_country_code
    FROM party.party
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'
) AS d
    ON b.cppib_party_id_new = d.cppib_party_id_new3

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) AS cppib_sec_id_new3,
        cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
        cppib_currency_code,
        cppib_currency_of_exposure_code
    FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'
) AS e
    ON b.cppib_sec_id_new = e.cppib_sec_id_new3

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        country_code,
        country_name
    FROM reference.reference_country_codes
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'
) AS f
    ON e.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = f.country_code

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        currency_code,
        currency_name
    FROM reference.reference_currency_codes
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'
) AS g
    ON e.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code = g.currency_code

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        id_model_portfolio,
        unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
    FROM finance_accounting.model_portfolios
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'
) AS mp
    ON a.id_model_portfolio = mp.id_model_portfolio

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        business_date,
        rating_Value,
        cppib_party_id
    FROM risk_prod.cppib_party_rating
    WHERE CAST(business_date AS DATE) = DATE '2025-06-19'
      AND rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
) AS r
    ON CAST(r.cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) = CAST(b.cppib_party_id_new AS VARCHAR)
LEFT JOIN (select cppib_sec_id, price_value from market.cppib_prices where business_date = date '2025-06-19' and session_code = 'EOD') as price
    on cast(price.cppib_sec_id as varchar) = a.underlying_cppib_sec_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        CAST(cppib_party_id AS INT) AS party_cppib_party_id,
        cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
        cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
        cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
        cppib_country_of_exposure_code AS party_cppib_country_of_exposure_code
    FROM party.party_enterprise_classification
    WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-19'
) AS pr
    ON pr.party_cppib_party_id = CAST(b.cppib_party_id_new AS INT)

			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM

		AND day = 20

	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 06:18:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 07 and 08
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 07:31:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact,

	SELECT f.analytic_value AS pv
	FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
		JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
	WHERE f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
		AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
		AND f.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
		AND h.ACCOUNT = 'ACPP'
		AND h.node_level = 2
),

	SELECT f.analytic_value AS pv

		JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID

		AND h.ACCOUNT = 'BCPP'

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 20:35:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 18 and 19
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 18:16:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with old_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'N'
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
new_breached_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *
    from new_breached_records
),
old_alert_records as (
    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        max(business_date) first_alert_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_alert = 'N'
    group by limit_name,

),

            select limit_id
            from old_alert_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),

    select *

    union all
    select *
    from new_alert_records
)

WITH

    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (

                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,

                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency

                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 20
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-20 04:30:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::509f4757af199b4bfc1b2688817b4c38b9696c042e1a58c51c121cd95db80455 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 19 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 20 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-19 23:41:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "business_date", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "ultimate_parent_party_name", "issuer_name", "parent_security_type_name", "security_type_name", "security_name", "total_market_value_pc", "security_name_clean", "combined_entity_name_original", "combined_entity_name_clean", "department_sorted"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'

WITH

  LATEST_BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT MAX(source_business_date) AS bdate, MAX(chron_id) AS chron_id
  FROM risk_prod.dim_chron C WHERE C.CANONICAL_SOURCE='1'
  AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM risk_prod.DIM_CR_EXP_LEGAL_ENTITY LE	WHERE C.CHRON_ID = LE.CHRON_ID )),

  SINGLE_BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT source_business_date AS bdate, chron_id AS chron_id
  FROM risk_prod.dim_chron C WHERE source_business_date= date'2025-06-19' and C.CANONICAL_SOURCE='1'
  AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM risk_prod.DIM_CR_EXP_LEGAL_ENTITY LE	WHERE C.CHRON_ID = LE.CHRON_ID )),

  BUSINESS_DATE AS
  (SELECT * FROM SINGLE_BUSINESS_DATE), -- Select your date here

  IP_PV AS
  (SELECT FACT.analytic_value AS pv
  FROM BUSINESS_DATE bd,
      risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD fact,
      risk_prod.dim_chron c,
      risk_prod.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE node
	 WHERE
	  FACT.CHRON_ID = c.CHRON_ID
    AND c.chron_ID = bd.chron_id
	  AND fact.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = node.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
	  AND fact.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
	  AND FACT.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'IP'
	  AND node.node_level = 1),

  ACPP_PV AS
  ( SELECT
      f.analytic_value AS pv
    FROM
      BUSINESS_DATE bd,
      risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
      JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h
        on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
    WHERE
      f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
      AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
      AND f.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
      AND h.ACCOUNT='ACPP'
      AND h.node_level = 2),

  BCPP_PV AS
  ( SELECT
      f.analytic_value AS pv
    FROM
      BUSINESS_DATE bd,
      risk_prod.FACT_ANALYTIC_SD f
      JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account h
        on f.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID = h.DIM_HIERARCHY_NODE_ID
    WHERE
      f.CHRON_ID = bd.CHRON_ID
      AND f.ANALYTIC_TYPE = 'PV'
      AND f.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
      AND h.ACCOUNT='BCPP'
      AND h.node_level = 2),

  CE_LE AS (
	  SELECT
		PARENT.party_name,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) AS credit_exposure,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.ACPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS ACPP_credit_exposure,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.BCPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS BCPP_credit_exposure,
    MAX(PARENT.gics_sector) AS SECTOR,
    MAX(regexp_extract(PARENT.rtg_final, '^[A-D]{1,3}')) AS RATING
	  FROM
    BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity CHILD,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity PARENT,
    IP_PV pv
	  where
		fact.chron_id = bd.chron_id
		AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		/* Exclude all north american government positions */
		AND NOT ( (PARENT.is_government = 'Y' OR PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y') AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA') )
	  GROUP BY PARENT.party_name),

  CE_LE_CN AS (
	  SELECT
		sum( coalesce(FACT.credit_exposure, 0) ) AS credit_exposure,
    PARENT.domicile_country_code AS COUNTRY_CODE,
    max(parent.SOVR_FI_LIMIT) AS SOVR_FI_LIMIT
	  FROM
    BUSINESS_DATE bd,
		risk_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity CHILD,
		risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity PARENT,
    risk_prod.DIM_CR_EXP_POS_INST pos
	  where
		FACT.chron_id = bd.chron_id
    AND FACT.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
		AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		AND CHILD.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = PARENT.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
    AND UPPER(pos.product_type)<>'NETTING'
	AND IS_POS_FI = 'Y'
    AND (PARENT.SOVR_FI_LIMIT IS NOT NULL)
	  GROUP BY PARENT.domicile_country_code),

  CE_LE_SN AS (
	  SELECT
		PARENT.party_name,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.ACPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS acpp_credit_exposure,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.BCPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS bcpp_credit_exposure,
    MAX(PARENT.gics_sector) AS SECTOR,
    MAX(regexp_extract(PARENT.rtg_final, '^[A-D]{1,3}')) AS RATING,
    MAX(CASE
      WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.15
      WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y' AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')
      AND upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', 'CANADA') THEN 0  /* no limit */
      WHEN upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('CPP FI') THEN 0
      WHEN PARENT.rtg_final IS NULL THEN -1  /* cannot tell, so no limit */
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.1
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.075
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.05
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.03
      when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' then a_pv.pv * 0.025   --/* BB and below */
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.15
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.10
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.075
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.05
      when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' then a_pv.pv * 0.025   --/* BB and below */
      ELSE -2 /* Breach it big time, to indicate that a case was missed */
    END) AS ACPP_LIMIT,
    MAX(CASE
      WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.15
      WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y' AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')

      WHEN upper(PARENT.party_name) IN ('CPP FI') THEN 0
      WHEN PARENT.rtg_final IS NULL THEN -1  /* cannot tell, so no limit */
      when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' then b_pv.pv * 0.1
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.075

	AND IS_POS_FI = 'Y'

	  SELECT
		PARENT.party_name,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.ACPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS acpp_credit_exposure,
		sum( coalesce(FACT.BCPP_credit_exposure, 0) ) AS bcpp_credit_exposure,
    MAX(PARENT.gics_sector) AS SECTOR,

    MAX(CASE
      WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.15
      WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y' AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')

      WHEN PARENT.rtg_final IS NULL THEN -1  /* cannot tell, so no limit */
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.1
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.075

      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.15
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.10
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.075
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN a_pv.pv * 0.05
      when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' then a_pv.pv * 0.025   --/* BB and below */
      ELSE -2 /* Breach it big time, to indicate that a case was missed */

      WHEN PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' AND upper( PARENT.party_name ) LIKE 'PROVINCE OF ONTARIO%' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.15
      WHEN PARENT.is_government = 'Y' AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' AND PARENT.domicile_country_code IN ('US', 'CA')

      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.075
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.05
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.03
      when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'N' then b_pv.pv * 0.025   --/* BB and below */
      when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '^AAA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' then b_pv.pv * 0.15
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^AA[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.1
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^A[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.075
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( PARENT.rtg_final, '^BBB[\+\-]?$' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' THEN b_pv.pv * 0.05
      when regexp_like( parent.rtg_final, '(^B{1,2}[\+\-]?$|C|D)' ) AND PARENT.is_provincial = 'Y' then b_pv.pv * 0.025   --/* BB and below */
      ELSE -2 --/* Breach it big time, to indicate that a case was missed */
    END) AS BCPP_LIMIT
	  FROM
    BUSINESS_DATE bd,
    risk_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
    risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity CHILD,
    risk_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity PARENT,
    ACPP_PV a_pv,

SELECT * from (
            SELECT from_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end, 8) as mid_price, 
                format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot')
            UNION
            SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
                format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
            Left Join ( 
                SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date
                FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            ) as CAD_Rate on MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
            WHERE MainTable.business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD' and MainTable.mid_price != 0 and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
